t: Great Trek: Zulu impis massacred about 532 Voortrekkers, Khoekhoe, and Basuto near present-day Weenen, South Africa.
The British soldier-explorer John Wood came close to rediscovering the ancient Greco-Bactrian city of Ai-Khanoum in modern Afghanistan.
At least 28 unarmed Indigenous Australians were massacred at Myall Creek, New South Wales.
The Maryland province of the Jesuits contracted to sell 272 slaves to buyers in Louisiana in one of the largest slave sales in American history.
A Cherokee band attacked settlers near Larissa, Texas, killing or abducting 18 people.
